text: On XX/XX/XXXX I was called by a person that was using the Bank of America. Customer service number and they informed me my account was being hacked, and the only way I was able to stop it was to send {$1100.00} of money to myself through XXXX. The people on the phone were able to tell me how much I had in my bank account, they informed me what the last 4 of my debit card was, so at the time, I had no reason to believe they were not employed by Bank of America. Bank of America told me they were unable to return my funds to me.

meta.issue: Unauthorized transactions or other transaction problem
